notes.title: 9 years of robots, top hats, soup and more!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32964518/4b73d23a3dde4a631015576d9e05796ca7030059.jpg

Phew! We are so glad that 2020 is over, and now we can dive into 2021 celebrating 9 years of Robot Gentleman together with you ️🎉🤖🎩

We want to thank you from the bottom of our robotic hearts for being with us for so many years, for supporting us, for making an amazing community. You are the reason why we want to create games for the rest of our lives. Thank you so much for that ❤️

Last months were pretty crazy, but we won't bore you with stories about how challenging was shifting our workflow to the virtual studio model or how much we miss seeing each other at Pyramida Hub. We will share these stories (maybe) next time. 

We must admit that our hands are full as we're currently working on new content for both 60 Seconds! Reatomized and 60 Parsecs!. Yes, there will be more to discover and more to survive in your beloved radioactive adventures. Keep your eyes on us! 

There is also something completely new. Something as new as a brand new game that's being under development right now...

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32964518/aa45e2d0552cceecf84973a42f8c9d027f682a0a.jpg

This new game is yet to be announced, but we can't wait for the moment when we will be sharing more details with you. Stay tuned, 2021 is going to be exciting!

Don't miss our special anniversary discounts on 60 Seconds! Reatomized and 60 Parsecs! - celebrating with soup and apocalypse is mandatory!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1012880/60_Seconds_Reatomized/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/646270/60_Parsecs/

Thank you so much again for being with us! 
Stay with us, stay awesome and may the soup be with you!

- Robot Gentleman Team
